rehearsal.ranFrom: a clean checkout of the release commit, with --ci-run naming the producer CI run

inspection.againstPrevious: Against the published 5.14.0: the same 86 files by count. dist/index.js, its map and dist/index.d.ts change for toastContainer, toastPlacement, TOAST_PLACEMENTS, the notice event and the settings dialogs' Cancel; dist/quickcharts.css adds the notice placements and the host space and drops the dialogs' own Cancel recipes; the theme manifest rewords control.outline; package.json and the feature manifest change the version; README.md and CHANGELOG.md document the changes. The export map, LICENSE, NOTICE, THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md, dist/drawings.js and the REST description are unchanged.

ownerWaiver.statement: Yes, I give you approval for anything quick charts related. You can do all that yourself too.
ownerWaiver.question: Approval to release Quick Charts 5.15.0 end to end (acceptance record, tag, release.yml, npm-publish) while the owner was away.
ownerWaiver.answerDetail: Said by the owner in the trdrs-app main session and relayed word for word to the release session. Manual accessibility and advertised browser and device acceptance were not performed; the browser suites passed in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.
